authorScope: reviewer authored 09,21-30; 09 reviewed independently in review-09.json
method: Full-text reading in batches 01-02,03-04,05-06,07,08-10 (excluding self-authored 09); a truncated initial combined read was corrected by rereading 01 in full. seriesObservation: 01/05/06/07 share an industrial evaluation motif by assignment. They differ in material provenance, orbital allocation, labor bargaining and field procurement respectively.
